modmenu.summaryTranslation.redstone_trai: Record block-state changes as outlines and compare multiple trails.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.redstone_:
Outline blocks whose state changes in redstone circuits and other builds.

• Permanent recording: use Start/Stop to accumulate lasting trails.
• Temporary trails: toggle independently, or run alongside permanent recording.
• Edit color, line width, transparency, lifetime and three fade behaviors.
• Save multiple comparisons, then show, hide, edit or delete each one. Saved outlines keep the original size and position.

Join a world and open /rt or the configuration button. Settings and comparisons are stored per world/server.

Client-only. Detects server-reported block-state changes; cannot detect power passing through solid blocks whose state does not change.
redstone_trail.about_world: Join a world or server, then use this configuration button again or enter /rt. Trails and settings are managed per world/server.
redstone_trail.about_controls: Use Start/Stop for lasting trails. The separate temporary-trail toggle works independently; both can run at the same time.
redstone_trail.about_saved: Edit color, width and transparency for current or saved trails, and compare multiple saved trails using show, hide and delete.
redstone_trail.title: Redstone Trail
redstone_trail.clear_hint: Clears the persistent recording and stops it. Temporary trails and saved comparisons are kept.
redstone_trail.radius_hint: 16 / 32 / 64 / 128 blocks. Persistent recording uses the start position; temporary trails follow the player. Stop recording to change the shared radius.
redstone_trail.started: Trail recording started · /rt to stop or clear
redstone_trail.limit: Trail limit reached · stopped and kept existing marks
redstone_trail.load_failed: Cannot read trails · original file preserved
redstone_trail.save_failed: Save failed · trails remain in memory
redstone_trail.hint0: 1. Start recording, then activate a lever or button.
redstone_trail.hint1: 2. Changed blocks keep an orange outline.
redstone_trail.hint2: 3. Trails survive stop and reconnect. Clear to erase.
redstone_trail.hint3: All state changes in range · received server updates only
redstone_trail.name: Name
redstone_trail.fade_hint.over_lifetime: Fade from activation until the lifetime ends.
redstone_trail.fade_hint.instant: Stay fully visible, then disappear at expiry.
redstone_trail.fade_hint.after_duration: Stay for the lifetime, then fade for the extra duration.
redstone_trail.temporary_hint0: Use the separate switch in the main menu; no Start needed.
redstone_trail.temporary_hint1: Time since last activation; turning Off clears only live marks.
redstone_trail.temporary_hint2: Follows the player; keeps working after recording stops.
redstone_trail.snapshot_hint0: Copies persistent marks only; excludes temporary marks.
redstone_trail.snapshot_hint1: Clearing a recording keeps comparisons and live trails.
redstone_trail.snapshot_limit: Needs a trail · max 16 snapshots / 32,768 saved blocks
redstone_trail.no_saved: Use Save comparison to keep the current trail.
redstone_trail.delete_hint: Deletes only this snapshot. Other trails are kept.
redstone_trail.main_hint: Recording and the temporary switch work independently.
